title: Photo 139 · 머슬 아워글래스 BBW · 마키에 · 엎드린 자세 · 흑인 40대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a horizontal landscape-orientation photograph, 3:2 aspect ratio, wider than it is tall.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless mid-grey backdrop, nothing in the frame but a low flat platform, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Black woman in her late 40s, faint lines at the eyes and mouth, deep near-black skin tone, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, void complexion, not brown, not lightened, her face exactly as dark as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a sleek chignon with a carved pin, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears large square earrings and has almond nails with a matte finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so long and vast that her head and her feet are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. Huge rounded shoulders and massive thick arms with the swell of the biceps and triceps showing through a soft layer of fat, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — a shadowed groove running around her middle, the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward, the muscle of her core firm beneath it. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat on her middle is squeezed out past her body on both sides where her weight presses it against the platform, spreading sideways into two or three heavy rounded folds with deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, a gigantic powerful rear, colossal thighs with the great sweep of the quads visible under a soft layer, thick heavy calves with a diamond shape showing through, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Wide at the bust, drawn in at the waistline, wide again below: the silhouette reads as a great hourglass at the most extreme size. Powerful and heavy at once, no bodybuilder leanness, the weight of the flesh visible in how it hangs over the muscle beneath. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is softer and looser at this age, each fold hanging lower and settling further over the one below it. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it spreads sideways and presses flat against the platform beneath her.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a coarser surface grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, crepey texture in the deepest folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Japanese maki-e lacquer style — glossy black lacquer with sprinkled gold powder shading into flowing autumn grasses, chrysanthemums, plum branches and full moons, bold gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs, a scattered gold-flake ground filling the space between every motif. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Lying face down on the platform, her upper body propped up on both forearms with her elbows planted wide apart and her head raised and turned toward the camera, her legs straight and slightly apart, a colossal rear rising as two enormous rounded mounds far above the line of her back with a deep shadowed cleft between them, her broad heavy back built from massive horizontal rolls of soft flesh, her thighs flattening wide where they meet the platform, her body stretching across the full width of the frame from edge to edge.

Footwear: Extreme gold platform stiletto sandals with twin instep straps, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the gold powder glittering, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Horizontal 3:2 landscape-orientation full-body photograph, wider than it is tall.
